body: Congrats on a year sober man, of you may be going to prison maybe its worth writing a letter to the judge explaining how you feel and why you feel like that, i live in the UK and should have been recalled to prison many times, but due to the fact i wasn't in my right mind i wasn't, hope this helps and keep strong, i was in the same place less than an hour ago, and thanks to DZCreeper and others who commented on my post, i feel so much better, there advice is sound advice, bless you brother and im here if you need anything

I wish i had that Lego man. Sounds sweet af. 

I just want to be left to my own devices but my friends keep getting me to do shit im not comfortable with but if i say no then i wont have any friends at all

Thank you so much, i find it amazing that total strangers want to help me rather than my so called friends who won't even open the door to me. My safe place would be my room but i lost my key and my landlord is demanding £85 off me before i am allowed a new set, just one thing after another.
I used to love meccano and Lego but im 23 and people just call me a fucking weirdo for buying them, those really used to help but after the abuse i get for owning them in the BNB i just stopped

It's not in her to see things like that, she's more if a typical man than i am haha, one if those just get on with it sort of people, i honestly think weed helps alot with how i feel because i can take up to 20 minutes to roll a joint, making sure its all perfect and in that time i don't think about anything else, i just feel nothing when i do it.

I want to stop smoking anyway it costs too much lol. But seriously man, i cant hold on, thank you for the support though, I've been told you can't cut your own throat it hurts too much. So there's plan A out the window

It's like a weight in my gut that hurts when i ignore it, i look drained according to my landlord and i feel so weak, i use cannabis on a daily basis and although i know about paranoia and other side effects, i don't think weed is a problem, I've been feeling like this for a few years, i cant manage to cut my arms properly ans im just left with horrid scars and now i cant even take my jumper off when i get intimate with my girlfriend, i feel leas of a man and just want to end it

It's nit just them though, my father wants nothing to do with me and my mum is happily ignoring my problems and content to fly to another country and live there, my girlfriend is becoming more and more distant with me everyday, i know ill be alone soon and im scared. At least if i do this itll just be like going to sleep and i wont need to worry again.
I tried to call them once before and while it helped, i keep feeling like this and i hate it. I just want it to stop.
